_note: Home-care product types, not brands, and no medicated products. The agent searches this catalogue; a live version would query retailer listings.

soft_brush.name: Soft-bristle toothbrush
soft_brush.look_for: Soft or extra-soft bristles and a small head. Replace it every 3 months.

why.default: Cleans well without wearing down gums or enamel.
why.mouth_ulcer: Gentler around a sore spot than medium or hard bristles.

fluoride_paste.name: Fluoride toothpaste
fluoride_paste.look_for: 1,000 to 1,500 ppm fluoride on the label (adult strength).

why.default: Fluoride strengthens enamel and helps stop early decay.
why.caries: The most effective everyday protection against new decay.

interdental_brush.name: Interdental brushes
interdental_brush.look_for: A pack of mixed sizes. Use the largest that slides in without forcing.

why.default: Reaches the gaps between teeth, where tartar and gum disease start.
why.hypodontia: Cleans the sides of teeth next to a gap.

floss.name: Dental floss or floss picks
floss.look_for: Waxed floss slides more easily between tight teeth.

why.default: Removes plaque between teeth before it can harden into tartar.

sls_free_paste.name: SLS-free fluoride toothpaste
sls_free_paste.look_for: "SLS-free" or "no sodium lauryl sulfate" on the label, with fluoride.

why.default: Some people with frequent mouth ulcers find foaming agents irritating.
